people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
translations.bsb: If Abraham was indeed justified by works, he had something to boast about, but not before God.
translations.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
translations.asv: For if Abraham was justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not toward God.
